title: The Improvement of the Moral Qualities

description: 11th-century accessible analysis of 20 personality traits divided by the senses to which they correspond. Complete Musar text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Musar is Jewish ethical and devotional literature concerned with character, discipline and the conduct of ordinary life. Its genre ranges from short letters to systematic treatises.
